literal: birth great-ocean they-will-swim they-will-not-swim Lord feet those-who-do-not-join
translation: They will swim across the great ocean of births; those who do not join the feet of the Lord will not swim across.
modern: இறைவனின் திருவடிகளைச் சேராதவர்கள் பிறவி என்னும் பெருங்கடலைக் கடக்க மாட்டார்கள்; சேர்ந்தவர்கள் கடப்பார்கள்.
explanation: The couplet compares the cycle of births to a vast ocean. It states that those who reach the feet of the Lord will successfully swim across this ocean. Conversely, those who do not seek the Lord's feet will remain unable to cross it. The contrast between swimming and not swimming emphasizes the necessity of divine refuge to overcome worldly existence.
